prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original polished 2D pixel art for a cozy idle fantasy exploration game. True crisp pixel clusters and clean retro RPG silhouettes, richly detailed but readable, beautiful restrained colors, no blur, no painterly strokes or photorealism. No text, letters, numbers, HUD, watermark or decorative border. A perfectly regular 3 by 3 contact sheet of NINE distinct full-body friendly companion characters, each centered in one equal square cell with ample identical transparent margins and no overlap. Transparent background, no floors, no boxes, no shadows extending beyond the character. Front three-quarter facing right, cohesive chunky pixel art, expressive eyes, charming collectible game mascots. Row 1: a round moss-green slime with tiny leaves; a stout hooded human traveler carrying a brass lantern; a friendly green forest guardian in leaf armor. Row 2: an orange small fox with a glowing lantern-like tail; an elegant tiny moon-antler deer with pale blue flowers; a cheerful brown river otter wearing a little blue scarf and carrying a shell. Row 3: a cream owl with star markings and a small purple scholar cape; a chubby honey bear wearing a tiny apron and carrying a honey pot; a graceful pale turquoise snowbird with frost feathers. Each fills about 70 percent of its cell. Exactly nine subjects in exact row order, uniform 3-column 3-row grid, no accessories crossing cells. Square overall atlas.
